hook.text: Fermentation Flavors: a surprising example shows why better reasoning matters.

buildup.text: Microbes break down sugars and proteins, producing organic acids, alcohols, esters, and aldehydes.

discovery.text: Fermented soy sauce contains over 300 flavor compounds. Unfermented soy has almost none.

twist.text: Different microbe strains produce entirely different results from the same ingredient.

climax.text: Cocoa beans must be fermented for 5–7 days before roasting. Without fermentation, chocolate tastes astringent and bitter.

punchline.text: Fermentation Flavors: the goal is not certainty, but sharper thinking.

quiz.question: Why must cocoa beans be fermented before making chocolate?
options: Without fermentation chocolate tastes astringent and bitter—fermentation develops the flavor
